description: This file implements the SensorsHalProxy class and related functions for handling sensor data and communication with the sensor hardware abstraction layer (HAL) in a sensor simulator environment. It includes functions for processing requests, updating sensor data, and managing threads for communication and monitoring.

classes.name: SensorsHalProxy
classes.description: Class responsible for managing sensor HAL communication, processing requests, and reporting sensor data in a simulated environment.

methods.name: SensorIdToName
methods.description: Converts sensor ID to its string name.

methods.name: SendResponseHelper
methods.description: Helper function to send a response message over the channel.

methods.name: ProcessHalRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming HAL requests, such as listing sensors.

methods.name: UpdateSensorsHal
methods.description: Updates sensor data reports based on the provided sensor data string.
